meta.name: Generate Image with a Style Reference (Krea 2 Turbo)
meta.licenseNote: Krea 2 Community License (Krea.ai, 2026-06-22) for the base model; Ostris's krea2_turbo_style_reference LoRA lists the same krea-2-community-license on Hugging Face (checked 2026-10-11). Commercial use is allowed with conditions; read krea.ai/krea-2-licensing.
meta.notes: Node names and settings follow ComfyUI's official 'Image Style Reference (Krea-2 Turbo)' template (image_krea2_turbo_int8_image_style_reference.json): UNETLoader → LoraLoaderModelOnly (Ostris's krea2_style_reference, strength 1) → ModelSamplingFlux (max_shift 1.15, base_shift 0.5, the output size), CLIPLoader type krea2, TextEncodeQwenImageEditPlus with the references on image1/image2 → FluxKontextMultiReferenceLatentMethod (index_timestep_zero), ConditioningZeroOut as the negative, CFGGuider at CFG 1, SamplerCustomAdvanced with RandomNoise, KSamplerSelect euler and BasicScheduler simple 8 steps, EmptyLatentImage, VAEDecode. The official graph's optional prompt-enhance switch (TextGenerate) is left out (PhotoCraft's own enhancer covers it) and its int8 checkpoint is swapped for the fp8 one the plain Krea 2 template uses. The LoRA was trained for one or two references (model card), so two slots. Verified against a live server's /object_info on 2026-10-11; not run live (the LoRA is not installed on the development PC).
meta.creator: Krea
meta.description: Text to image in the style of one or two reference images
